Founded by Dr Gemma Campling, a global veterinary charity, working in 10 countries and across 5 continents. Our mission is to improve animal welfare globally by expanding access to veterinary care and building the knowledge, skills and resources needed to provide sustainable veterinary services. 

“Treating animals today, training vets for tomorrow”

Want to get involved and join our mission, click the link below  👇
https://www.worldwide-vets.org
